items.name: Claude Fable 5.1
items.why: Fable 5.1 是 Fable 5 的更新版本，Fable 5 已被譽為遊戲開發的強大工具，並在編碼和知識工作方面表現卓越，於本月正式發布。

items.name: Qwen3.8-Max-0902

items.name: Combos
items.why: 於 Gamescom 2026 全球首次亮相，這是一個專門的 AI 遊戲創作平台，能將自然語言描述轉化為可玩的瀏覽器遊戲。
items.why_en: Globally debuted at Gamescom 2026, it's a dedicated AI game creation platform that transforms natural language descriptions into playable browser games.

items.name: DeepSeek V4-Pro-0813
items.why: 於 8 月中旬正式發布，並進行了重大的代理升級，被譽為遊戲開發的「演算法秘密武器」，擅長路徑尋找、程序生成、物理優化和著色器數學。
items.why_en: Officially released in mid-August with a major agent upgrade, it's hailed as an 'algorithmic secret weapon' for game development, excelling in pathfinding, procedural generation, physics optimization, and shader math.

items.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash

items.name: Meshy Auto-rigging & Animation API
items.why: 正式推出自動綁骨與動畫API，大幅擴展開發者整合其AI綁骨與動畫功能的能力。

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio 3D Editor + Canvas

items.name: Meshy 7

items.name: Tripo UniRig
items.why: 其自動綁骨功能持續獲得更新與強化，保持其在快速角色綁骨領域的競爭力。
items.why_en: Its auto-rigging capabilities received continuous updates and enhancements, maintaining its competitiveness in rapid character rigging.

items.name: Suno v6 系列

items.name: Adobe Premiere Pro 生成式媒體工具 (音效生成)

items.why_en: Integrates AI sound effects generation directly into Premiere Pro's timeline, significantly enhancing efficiency and creative control for professional video editing workflows.

items.name: Difro Melody AI

items.name: ElevenLabs Music Composer
items.why: ElevenLabs Music 的重要功能更新，允許逐段編輯歌曲，提升音樂創作的精細控制。
items.why_en: A significant feature update for ElevenLabs Music, enabling section-by-section song editing and enhancing fine-grained control over music creation.

items.name: xAI Console
